## Change

What behavior changes, and why?

## Verification

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py` passes on macOS; otherwise list the suites actually run.
- [ ] Privacy check passes; fixtures and screenshots are synthetic.
- [ ] Native UI checked in the full window and 360×600 widget, when changed.
- [ ] Accounting coverage, unavailable values and local-data compatibility are preserved.
- [ ] User-facing changes are described in CHANGELOG.md and affected documentation.

List the commands, results, and a synthetic reproduction for a bug fix. Never
attach an Application Support archive, raw wallet history, or credentialed URLs.

## Limits

State anything not verified or intentionally deferred. Public publication requires
separate owner approval; a merge does not authorize it.
